_source: https://api.github.com/repos/decentraland/creator-hub/releases/latest (decentraland/creator-hub GitHub Releases API, public, no auth). Snapshot of the latest release on 2026-06-23. The real download page (decentraland.org/download/creator-hub) resolves these via useLatestGithubRelease(Repo.CREATOR_HUB) + useCreatorHubDownload's OS detection (primaryOption / secondaryOptions of Windows/macOS, amd64/arm64). No catalyst crate backs this story — download URLs are static GitHub release asset links.
_notes: Only installer assets are surfaced (the .dmg / .exe). The .zip, .blockmap and latest*.yml entries from the release are electron-updater artifacts, not user-facing downloads, so they are excluded. macOS arm64 is the default primaryOption (matches ui3 StCreatorHubDownload's placeholder). OS detection is server-side from the User-Agent in the route loader; ?os=windows|macos and ?arch=arm64|amd64 override it for QA / journey screenshots. The download itself is a real GitHub link (an <a href>); there is no on-chain or backend write, so nothing is SIMULATED here.

systemRequirements.macos: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon or Intel).
